content:
Placing your OpenSearch Service domain within a virtual private cloud (VPC) helps enable secure
communication between OpenSearch Service and other services within the VPC—without the need
for an internet gateway, NAT device, or VPN connection. All traﬃc remains securely within the AWS
Cloud. Because of their logical isolation, domains that reside within a VPC have an extra layer of
security compared to domains that use public endpoints.
We recommend that you create your domains within a VPC.
